articles.title: AI Factories: The New Infrastructure of Intelligence
articles.summary: AI factories are token factories, converting power into intelligence in real time. And as agentic AI scales and autonomous, always-on special agents are deployed in the enterprise, performance per watt and cost per token become the economics that matter.
articles.author: Jeremy Graybill

articles.title: NVIDIA Vera CPU Is ‘Packing a Heavy-Hitting Punch’ Against Competition
articles.summary: The shift to agentic AI creates a new CPU requirement for the AI factory: fast cores, massive memory bandwidth and the ability to sustain high performance when all cores are active. Initial benchmark results published by Phoronix today show that the NVIDIA Vera CPU meets this need. For this first public look, the benchmark scope […]
